_doc: THE SEED DENYLIST: a scrub over seed/seed_pack.json that runs BEFORE the loader writes
a row. Every pattern is a regular expression matched case-insensitively against the
WHOLE pack file's text (every field, not only content). organs/seed_loader.py refuses
the whole load, typed SEED_DENYLIST_HIT (rc 4), on any hit, naming the class and the
byte offset, never the matched text (a refusal that prints the secret is a second leak).
Run it yourself: python3 organs/claude_memory_lite.py seed-scrub.
This shipped list is a GENERIC EXAMPLE of the mechanism: shapes that should never ride
inside a starter pack meant for strangers (home-directory paths, private hostnames,
credential shapes, hardware identifiers) plus two placeholder names showing where a
maintainer lists the client and person names of their own context. If you build your
own pack, add your own names here; keep private lists out of a public repository.
